answer_1.quote: a non-autoregressive CUC-VAE TTS system was proposed to synthesize speech with better naturalness and more prosody diversity

answer_2.quote: FFE combined the Gross Pitch Error (GPE) and the Voicing Decision Error (VDE)... MCD evaluated the timbral distortion... word error rates (WER) from an ASR model... the diversity of samples was evaluated by measuring the standard deviation of two prosody attributes... relative energy (E) and fundamental frequency (F0)

answer_4.quote: a subjective listening test was performed over 11 synthesized audios with 23 volunteers asked to rate the naturalness of speech samples on a 5-scale mean opinion score (MOS) evaluation... an AB test was conducted... 23 volunteers were asked to choose the preference audio
answer_4.guideline: Rate naturalness on a 5-point MOS scale and choose preference in AB test
